ei.title: The Impact of Light on Health
ei.subject: 공통영어1

fullPassage:
The Impact of Light on Health

Sunlight offers numerous health benefits. In small amounts, it boosts vitamin D levels, makes the bones stronger, prevents diseases, and heals skin conditions. Sunlight also affects mental health. Natural light causes the release of serotonin, a natural chemical the brain produces to promote happiness and pleasure and reduce depression and anxiety. On the other hand, reductions in sunlight are linked to panic attacks and anxiety-related disorders.

However, the impact of light extends beyond sunlight. Colors created by artificial light can cause different emotions and have other effects on the body. Blue and white light energize us, but they can also disturb sleep patterns by lowering levels of melatonin, a chemical made in the brain that regulates night-and-day cycles and sleep-wake cycles. The brain has the most sensitivity to blue light.

In contrast, red and yellow light are the least likely to impact our bodies. Exposure to red light in the evening can improve mental health by increasing the release of melatonin, which leads to better sleep at night. This improves people's cognitive abilities and overall mental health.

questions.passage:
The Impact of Light on Health

Sunlight ①<u>offers</u> numerous health benefits. In small amounts, it boosts vitamin D levels, makes the bones ②<u>stronger</u>, ③<u>preventing</u> diseases, and ④<u>heals</u> skin conditions.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: 햇빛은 수많은 건강 이점을 제공한다. 비타민 D 수치를 높이고 뼈를 더 강하게 만들고 질병을 예방하고 피부 질환을 치유한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① offers: 주어 Sunlight(3인칭 단수)에 맞는 동사. 올바름.
✅ ② stronger: makes the bones stronger. 비교급 올바름.
❌ ③ preventing: 원문 prevents. boosts, makes, prevents, heals 병렬 구조에서 preventing은 형태 불일치. ←정답
✅ ④ heals: 병렬 구조 동사. 올바름.
det.tip: 병렬 구조: boosts, makes, prevents, heals 모두 현재 시제 동사. preventing(동명사)은 불일치.

questions.passage: Sunlight also affects mental health. Natural light ①<u>causing</u> the release of serotonin, a natural chemical the brain ②<u>produces</u> ③<u>to promote</u> happiness and pleasure and reduce depression and anxiety. On the other hand, reductions in sunlight are ④<u>linked</u> to panic attacks and anxiety-related disorders.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: 자연광은 세로토닌의 분비를 유발한다. 뇌가 생산하는 자연 화학물질. 행복을 촉진하고. 공황 발작과 연결된.
det.analysis:
❌ ① causing: 원문 causes. Natural light causes가 주절 동사인데 causing으로 바꾸면 주어에 동사 없음. ←정답
✅ ② produces: 관계절 내 동사. the brain produces. 올바름.
✅ ③ to promote: to부정사 목적 표현. 올바름.
✅ ④ linked: are linked to 수동태. 올바름.
det.tip: 주절에는 정동사(causes)가 필요. causing(현재분사)은 주절 동사 역할 불가.

questions.passage: However, the impact of light extends beyond sunlight. Colors ①<u>created</u> by artificial light can cause different emotions and have other effects on the body. Blue and white light ②<u>energizing</u> us, but they can also disturb sleep patterns by ③<u>lowering</u> levels of melatonin, a chemical ④<u>made</u> in the brain that regulates night-and-day cycles and sleep-wake cycles.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: 인공 빛에 의해 만들어진 색상. 파란색과 흰색 빛은 우리에게 활력을 준다. 멜라토닌 수치를 낮추어. 뇌에서 만들어진 화학물질.
det.analysis:
✅ ① created: 과거분사. Colors created by artificial light. 올바름.
❌ ② energizing: 원문 energize. Blue and white light energize us가 주절인데 energizing은 정동사 아님. ←정답
✅ ③ lowering: by lowering levels. 전치사 + 동명사. 올바름.
✅ ④ made: 과거분사. a chemical made in the brain. 올바름.
det.tip: 주어(Blue and white light) + 동사(energize). energizing은 정동사 역할 불가.

questions.passage: In contrast, red and yellow light are the least ①<u>likely</u> ②<u>to impact</u> our bodies. Exposure to red light in the evening can improve mental health by ③<u>increasing</u> the release of melatonin, which ④<u>leading</u> to better sleep at night.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: 우리 몸에 영향을 미칠 가능성이 가장 적다. 영향을 미치다. 멜라토닌 분비를 증가시켜. 더 나은 수면으로 이끈다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① likely: the least likely to impact. 형용사 올바름.
✅ ② to impact: likely to + 동사원형. 올바름.
✅ ③ increasing: by increasing. 전치사 + 동명사. 올바름.
❌ ④ leading: 원문 leads. which leads to better sleep에서 관계절 동사가 필요한데 leading은 정동사 아님. ←정답
det.tip: which + 동사(leads). which leading은 문법 오류.

✅ ④ reductions(감소): 원문 그대로.
det.tip: reduce(줄이다) ↔ increase(증가시키다). serotonin reduces depression.

det.korean: 파란색과 흰색 빛은 우리에게 활력을 준다. 수면 패턴을 방해할 수 있다. 밤낮 주기를 조절하는. 파란 빛에 대한 민감성.

✅ ④ sensitivity(민감성): 원문 그대로.
det.tip: energize(활력을 주다) ↔ exhaust(지치게 하다).

questions.passage:
The Impact of Light on Health

Sunlight offers numerous health benefits. In small amounts, it boosts vitamin D levels, makes the bones stronger, prevents diseases, and heals skin conditions. Sunlight also affects mental health. Natural light causes the release of serotonin, a natural chemical the brain produces to promote happiness and pleasure and reduce depression and anxiety. On the other hand, reductions in sunlight are linked to panic attacks and anxiety-related disorders. 

However, the impact of light extends beyond sunlight. Colors created by artificial light can cause different emotions and have other effects on the body. Blue and white light energize us, but they can also disturb sleep patterns by lowering levels of melatonin, a chemical made in the brain that regulates night-and-day cycles and sleep-wake cycles.
